statements.status_notes: CVE-2008-0888 is a flaw in unzip 5.52's inflate_dynamic() in inflate.c: invalid data could make it free uninitialized or already-freed memory, crashing unzip and possibly allowing code execution. Info-ZIP's History.600 records the fix under 6.00d05 (2007), before the final 6.0 release: 'inflate_dynamic(): fixed erroneous huft_free() calls for unallocated memory when processing invalid data' (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madler/unzip/master/History.600). Debian fixed 5.52 in DSA-1522-1 and tracks every 6.0 release as fixed: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2008-0888. DHI unzip for Alpine 3.23 is built from unzip 6.0 and published as 6.0-r16.
